contract_answer.question: On paper split 2024 (BL_SPLIT=2024), does the ZN-E018 P0c quadratic late-knee physics loss configuration (whatif_knee_p0c, rho = 0.5, split-2024 calibrated lambda = 0.164158 on frozen ZN-E010) cut the held-out P0c violation rate by >= 50% versus matched no-physics reference ZN-E014 (0.0825) at near-matched accuracy so that the 3-split P0c aggregate over ZN-E018/ZN-E019/ZN-E020 is CONFIRMED?
contract_answer.conclusion: Reviewed by CODEX(gemini-4-argon). Apply the proposal's per-run disposition and amended 3-split aggregate rejection_condition exactly. (1) Per-run disposition: On paper split 2024 (BL_SPLIT=2024, seed 2021, Kaggle Tesla T4), ZN-E020 is a complete, finite 14-epoch confirmation run (644 optimizer steps, 46 steps/epoch, 358.094s training compute, 98,113 parameters, early stopping at epoch 14 after minimum validation MAPE 0.342019 at epoch 9 and epsilon-Pareto checkpoint selection at epoch 10 within the 0.005 tolerance). Executed train.py md5 equals the reviewed train.py. Before step 1, float64 unsigned gradient-norm calibration on 3 fixed split-2024 training batches yields batch ratios [0.375985, 0.328317, 0.327383] (median 0.328317) and calibrated lambda = 0.164158 (0.164) at rho = 0.5. From validation_predictions.npz and tools/rescore.py, ZN-E020 achieves MAPE 0.346401 (0.3464), Acc@15 0.3480, RMSE 382.663 cycles (382.7), MAE 226.108 cycles, DB-MAPE 0.346401, seen-condition MAPE 0.363587 (0.364, seen Acc@15 0.312222), and unseen-condition MAPE 0.191722 (0.192, unseen Acc@15 0.670000), compared against matched no-physics split-2024 reference ZN-E014 (MAPE 0.316227 [0.3162], Acc@15 0.3575, RMSE 400.811 cycles [400.8], MAE 224.700 cycles, seen MAPE 0.317569, unseen MAPE 0.304156). Held-out P0c violation on split 2024 falls from 0.0825 in reference ZN-E014 (at alpha = alpha_max = 0.167) to 0.0460 in ZN-E020 (276 / 6000 evaluations; 0.0460 at alpha = 0.25, 0.5, and 1.0 x alpha_max), a 44.24% reduction (-44%). Because the P0c hinge is dormant at sampled steps 1, 185, and 250 (active_fraction = 0.0, R = 0.0) before activating in epochs 9-14 (step 500: R = 0.361800 inside [0.05, 2.0], active_fraction = 0.0625, gradient cosine = -0.773251), diagnostics.json mechanically logs loss_balance = BALANCE_FAIL_SMALL (4-step median_R = 0.0) and summary.overall_gradient_health = WARNING (mapped by validate_analysis.py to gates.gradient = FAIL), while all 6 architectural blocks are HEALTHY with zero flags. Under the per-run disposition (VALID -> KEEP as physics-consistency confirmation evidence), ZN-E020 is KEEP. (2) 3-split aggregate decision (over ZN-E018 [2021], ZN-E019 [42], and ZN-E020 [2024]): 3-split P0c achieves MAPE 0.339 +/- 0.012 (0.338964 +/- 0.011776 <= 0.342 OK, and < 0.515 paper CPTransformer OK), Acc@15 0.296 +/- 0.067 (0.295833 +/- 0.066469 >= 0.294 OK), and RMSE 395 +/- 45 cycles (394.959 +/- 45.289 vs ZN-E010 3-split 392 +/- 38), satisfying accuracy criterion (b). However, physics criterion (a) requires >= 50% held-out violation reduction on every non-zero split (or <= 0.01 where reference is 0): split 2021 achieves -63% (0.149 -> 0.055, OK), split 42 stays 0.0 (<= 0.01, OK), but split 2024 achieves -44% (0.0825 -> 0.0460, < 50%, FAIL). Therefore, the 3-split P0c aggregate is NOT CONFIRMED.

main_symptom: On split 2024, ZN-E020 (frozen ZN-E010 + P0c quadratic knee loss, lambda = 0.1642) is a valid 14-epoch confirmation run (KEEP per per-run disposition) that improves RMSE to 382.7 cycles (vs 400.8 in matched no-physics ZN-E014), unseen-condition MAPE to 0.192 (vs 0.304), >1000-cycle MAPE/RMSE to 0.6045 / 852.2 cycles (vs 0.6157 / 920.2), and 500-1000-cycle Acc@15 to 0.205 (vs 0.060), while regressing headline MAPE to 0.3464 (vs 0.3162), seen-condition MAPE to 0.364 (vs 0.318), and Acc@15 slightly to 0.3480 (vs 0.3575), with gradient health WARNING and loss balance BALANCE_FAIL_SMALL (median R = 0.0 across steps 1/185/250/500, R = 0.3618 at step 500); critically, held-out P0c violation drops from 0.0825 to 0.0460 (-44.2%, short of the >= 50% threshold on split 2024), so despite the 3-split P0c aggregate passing accuracy criterion (b) with MAPE 0.339 +/- 0.012 (<= 0.342) and Acc@15 0.296 +/- 0.067 (>= 0.294), criterion (a) fails on split 2024 (-44% < 50%) and the 3-split P0c aggregate is NOT CONFIRMED.

contradicting_evidence: Across all 3 paper splits (ZN-E018 / ZN-E019 / ZN-E020), the P0c configuration satisfies every accuracy requirement of criterion (b): 3-split mean MAPE is 0.339 +/- 0.012 (<= 0.342 threshold and < 0.515 paper CPTransformer), 3-split mean Acc@15 is 0.296 +/- 0.067 (>= 0.294 threshold), and 3-split mean RMSE is 395 +/- 45 cycles (matching ZN-E010's 392 +/- 38).

On splits 2021 and 42, criterion (a) passes cleanly: ZN-E018 cuts split-2021 P0c violations by 63.0% (0.149 -> 0.0552), and ZN-E019 keeps split-42 P0c violations at 0.0000 (<= 0.01 where reference ZN-E013 is 0.0000).
causes.interpretation: On split 2024, unsigned float64 gradient calibration on 3 fixed training batches produces batch ratios [0.375985, 0.328317, 0.327383] (median 0.328317) and lambda = 0.164158 at rho = 0.5. Because the quadratic ramp r_n^2 = ((n-10)/90)^2 is near-zero on short and medium prefixes, the P0c hinge ReLU(f(x~) - sg[f(x)]) remains dormant during epochs 1-8 (raw_physics_loss_mean = 2.35e-6 in epoch 1, 0.0 in epochs 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 1.01e-11 in epoch 3, and 8.19e-8 in epoch 8; sampled steps 1, 185, and 250 all have active_fraction = 0.0 and R = 0.0). Only when long-life predictions expand strongly in epochs 9-14 (prediction SD jumping from 102.8 cycles at epoch 8 to 400.5-433.9 cycles in epochs 9-12) does P0c engage: raw_physics_loss_mean rises to 3.15e-5 (epoch 9), 4.40e-5 (epoch 10), and 3.13e-5 (epoch 11) before subsiding to 1.69e-5..2.62e-5 in epochs 12-14, with sampled step 500 (epoch 11) logging active_fraction = 0.0625 (8/128 samples), weighted-to-main gradient ratio R = 0.361800 inside [0.05, 2.0], and gradient cosine = -0.773251. At the selected epoch-10 checkpoint, held-out P0c violation is 0.0460 across all three alpha multipliers (0.25, 0.5, and 1.0 x alpha_max; 276 / 6000 evaluations) versus 0.0825 at alpha_max in matched no-physics ZN-E014. This -44.24% (-44%) reduction falls just short of the pre-registered >= 50% requirement (which needed <= 0.04125 on split 2024), so criterion (a) fails on split 2024 and the 3-split P0c aggregate is NOT CONFIRMED.

contradicting_evidence: Compared with matched no-physics ZN-E014 (selected epoch 7), ZN-E020 (selected epoch 10) reduces overall RMSE by -18.15 cycles (400.81 -> 382.66 cycles, falling further to 349.56 at epoch 14), expands prediction-to-target SD ratio from 0.5198 (215.35 cycles) to 0.9794 (405.82 cycles vs target SD 414.34), raises prediction-target correlation from 0.5592 to 0.6006, cuts overall underprediction bias nearly in half (-205.87 -> -109.80 cycles), improves unseen-condition MAPE on the 2 unseen validation cells (ZN-coin_442-1 and 432-3) from 0.3042 to 0.1917 (unseen Acc@15 0.280 -> 0.670), and boosts 500-1000-cycle Acc@15 from 0.0600 to 0.2050.
causes.interpretation: In ZN-E020, tiny early-epoch physics perturbations (epoch 1 raw_physics_loss_mean = 2.35e-6) shift the trajectory enough that epoch 7—where no-physics ZN-E014 reached its minimum MAPE of 0.3162—has MAPE 0.3774 in ZN-E020. Instead, ZN-E020 reaches its minimum validation MAPE at epoch 9 (0.342019, Acc@15 0.2625, RMSE 382.94) and selects epoch 10 under the 0.005 epsilon-Pareto tolerance rule (MAPE 0.346401 <= 0.347019, lifting Acc@15 from 0.2625 to 0.3480 and lowering RMSE to 382.66). At epoch 10, predictions have expanded to match the target distribution (prediction SD 405.82 vs target SD 414.34; max prediction 1975.42 vs 1160.91 in ZN-E014). Cell-level inspection of validation_predictions.npz explains both the RMSE/unseen gain and the seen-MAPE regression (0.3176 -> 0.3636): (1) upper-tail expansion strongly benefits long/mid-life cells ZN-coin_432-3 (unseen, EOL 923: mean pred 521.4 -> 809.5, MAPE 0.4351 -> 0.2212, Acc@15 0.00 -> 0.70), 439-2 (EOL 1380: mean pred 368.8 -> 702.5, MAPE 0.7328 -> 0.4909), and 438-2 (EOL 1377: mean pred 280.2 -> 397.0, MAPE 0.7965 -> 0.7117), cutting >1000-cycle RMSE from 920.18 to 852.17 cycles; (2) however, the same expansion causes over-prediction on seen cell ZN-coin_432-2 (EOL 341: mean pred 380.4 -> 562.2, max 787.0, MAPE 0.3637 -> 0.9017), seen mid-life cell 435-3 (EOL 603: mean pred 562.5 -> 840.1, MAPE 0.2860 -> 0.5649), and seen long-life cell 439-3 (EOL 1173: mean pred 800.3 -> 1484.9, max 1975.4, MAPE 0.3177 -> 0.6108, Acc@15 0.37 -> 0.00), lifting <500-cycle MAPE from 0.2037 to 0.2477 and overall MAPE from 0.3162 to 0.3464.
